findings.location: Paragraph: "Dalam dunia natural naluri \"orang lama\" kita cenderung...","html_tag":null
findings.source_quote: In the natural world our “old man” has the tendency to think that we must “do something” if we expect things to go in a “right” direction.
findings.suggested_fix: Adjust word order and punctuation for clearer Indonesian idiom. Example: "Dalam dunia alamiah, 'orang lama' kita cenderung berpikir bahwa kita harus 'melakukan sesuatu' jika berharap segala sesuatu berjalan ke arah yang 'benar'." Preserve the same HTML tag and placement.
findings.translation_quote: Dalam dunia natural naluri "orang lama" kita cenderung berpikir bahwa kita harus "melakukan sesuatu" jika kita berharap segala sesuatu berjalan ke arah yang "benar".

findings.location: Paragraph: "Pada akhirnya, kita harus mempercayai Allah untuk mewujudkan kehendak-Nya seiring berjalannya \"jam waktu\" menuju akhir zaman.",
findings.source_quote: Ultimately, we must trust God to bring about His will for the winding down of the “clock of time” as time speeds onward towards the end of time.
findings.suggested_fix: Consider a more idiomatic rendering of "clock of time" into Indonesian. Example: "seiring berputarnya 'jam waktu' menuju akhir zaman" or simply "seiring berjalannya waktu menuju akhir zaman." Either option preserves meaning; keep the existing HTML structure.
findings.translation_quote: Pada akhirnya, kita harus mempercayai Allah untuk mewujudkan kehendak-Nya seiring berjalannya "jam waktu" menuju akhir zaman.
